lead.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna for ChatGPT Voice with ChatGPT Work mode
lead.summary: OpenAI rolled out three GPT-6 variants powering ChatGPT Voice: Astra (general-purpose), Sol (reasoning-heavy), and Luna (cost-efficient). All support native plugin and tool use, plus a new ChatGPT Work mode enabling voice-driven document, slide, and spreadsheet creation. The release marks the first time GPT-6 models are available through the voice interface at full reasoning capability.

top_stories.title: Google DeepMind launches highly controllable Gemini TTS with SynthID audio watermarking
top_stories.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS offers fine-grained control over accent, pacing, emotion, laughs, and pauses, with SynthID watermarking for generated audio.

top_stories.title: Multi-agent collaboration via shared directory beats 4x independent agents on ARC-AGI-3
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Research showed k communicating agents via a shared directory match ~4k independent agents on ARC-AGI-3, and produced a 1,957-byte 99.4% MNIST classifier.

top_stories.title: Unitree launches Dex5-S dexterous hand with 22 DOF at ~$6,500
top_stories.summary: Unitree's human-scale five-finger robotic hand with 22 actively-controlled backdrivable joints signals intensifying competition in low-cost dexterous manipulation.

top_stories.title: China targets Broadcom switches in state data centers as AI stack push widens beyond GPUs
top_stories.summary: Beijing may issue informal guidance to cut reliance on Broadcom networking gear in state data centers, extending its domestic chip campaign beyond accelerators into networking silicon.

items.title: Decomposed subtask RL beats vanilla GRPO by 11-24% on AgentBench and WebArena
items.summary: DSRL segments rollouts into subtask-level segments and assigns rewards separately, achieving 3-5x faster convergence over monolithic credit assignment.

items.title: Agent-Editing World Model cuts LLM agent token cost by 2.5x while boosting success rate
items.summary: AWM edits the agent's internal belief state via a lightweight diff model instead of reconstructing full observations, achieving 28% higher task success on ALFWorld and WebArena.

items.title: On-policy distillation unifies teacher and student distributions for low-bit reasoning
items.summary: OPD recovers 94% of CodeContests and 96% of GSM8K accuracy at 2-bit weights versus 68% and 72% for offline quantization-aware distillation.

items.title: PACT aligns critic credit estimates with token-level outcomes, matching GRPO with 40% fewer steps
items.summary: Learns a dense reward model satisfying completeness, locality, and eligibility, with 2x higher correlation to held-out token-level outcomes.

items.title: SpeakerMem-R1 achieves 84% accuracy on multi-party dialogue memory benchmark
items.summary: Dual-track memory separating personal narratives from shared group knowledge outperforms existing multi-party memory systems by 18%.

items.title: Together AI releases Tev1-4B-experimental, a specialized classifier trained for $17
items.summary: A 'Jev-like' classifier fine-tuned on Qwen3.5-4B with weights on HuggingFace at togethercomputer/Tev1-4B-experimental. Served serverless at $0.042/M input tokens, $0 output.

items.title: Hunyuan-A13B: open-source 80B MoE with 13B active, deployable on a single consumer GPU
items.summary: Pretrained on 7.3T trilingual tokens. Achieves 78.4 C-Eval, 76.8 MMLU, 85.2 GSM8K with speculative decoding delivering 2.1x throughput improvement.

items.title: KITE: KV-cache-invariant transformer expansion adds layers without full retraining
items.summary: New layers inserted with KV-invariant initialization preserve the pre-trained output distribution. A 32B KITE-expanded model matches from-scratch with 40% less training compute.

items.title: Anthropic fixes Claude Opus — model improvements rolled out
items.summary: Anthropic has deployed a fix for Claude Opus, addressing issues with the flagship model. Theo - t3.gg covers what changed and how it affects performance.

items.title: Unitree launches Dex5-S dexterous hand with 22 DOF at ~$6,500
items.summary: Human-scale five-finger robotic hand with 22 actively-controlled backdrivable joints at a price point that signals intensifying competition in dexterous manipulation.

items.title: Qualcomm announces Snapdragon X2 will support Debian and Ubuntu Linux
items.summary: At Snapdragon Summit, Qualcomm confirmed Linux support for its Snapdragon X2 PC chips, enabling ARM-based Linux workstations and servers on Qualcomm silicon.

items.title: China targets Broadcom switches in state data centers as AI stack push widens beyond GPUs
items.summary: Beijing may issue informal guidance to cut Broadcom networking gear in state data centers, extending domestic chip campaign into datacenter networking silicon.

items.title: Alibaba announces international data center expansion across Europe and Middle East
items.summary: New cloud regions in Turkey, Finland, and the Netherlands; expanded footprints in Malaysia, Germany, UAE, France, and Hong Kong over the next 12 months.

items.title: Rabbit OS3 — agentic AI platform for desktop, Telegram, and iMessage
items.summary: Rabbit pivots from hardware to software with OS3, an agentic platform connecting Windows, Mac, and Linux computers via a local agent. Supports up to 5 computers per account.

items.title: Simular Sai GA — autonomous computer-use agent with fleet mode
items.summary: Sai runs computers autonomously for hours, spawns helper agents, and scales across 100 machines in parallel for less than $1/hour. Achieved 73% on OSWorld 2.0.

items.title: Meta unveils Muse Charm — Tamagotchi-like AI wearable keychain
items.summary: A palm-sized keychain device with a tiny screen and avatar for phone-free access to Meta's Muse AI agent. Fingerprint sensor, always-on voice stack, shipping by December.

items.title: UiPath Cartographer — enterprise 'Map of Work' builder for AI automation
items.summary: Builds a live Map of Work from process charts, mining data, and expert interviews. Coding agents then build automations from the map with a Decision Ledger for corrections.

items.title: SophIA launches with €27.5M for AI, startup and deep tech innovation
items.summary: CDP Venture Capital launches SophIA, a National Technology Transfer Hub dedicated to AI and cybersecurity, with five scientific partners. Aims to support over 20 deep tech initiatives in three years.

items.title: Enveda secures $311M Series E for AI drug discovery from nature
items.summary: Series E at $2B valuation, led by Catalio Capital Management and Iconiq. AI-powered drug discovery from plants and microbes, doubled valuation from 12 months ago.

items.title: Bessemer Venture Partners raises $5.75B across two AI-focused funds
items.summary: $1.75B for seed/early-stage and $4B for growth. Backed Anthropic, Cognition, Perplexity, Ramp. $3B already deployed into 260+ AI-native companies since 2022.

items.title: Modal Labs and Baseten in talks for funding at ~$15B and ~$26B valuations
items.summary: Modal raised $355M at $4.65B in May 2026; new round would roughly triple valuation. Baseten would double from $13B in June 2026.
